body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "Our aspiration is to go below 4.5%." Metric: Interest / revenue. Target: <4.5%. Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: FY25 finance cost INR 214 cr / revenue INR 4,624 cr = 4.63% (screener). Management's own later baseline for FY25: 'about 4.7%' (Nov-25), '4.8%' (Jan-26). In Apr-25 it said '4.4% right now', a quarterly figure. Explanation given: none; the miss was never acknowledged, and the FY25 base was later quoted higher, which flatters the FY26 improvement
